summary: The corrected RC6 evidence package satisfies the visual-evidence acceptance checks. Report paths are RC6-local, replay binding and counts are consistent, specimen-level insufficiency is explicit, and retained stage/tracking visuals show readable legends, consistent framing, aligned overlays and centerlines, and no apparent clipping or presentation of the one-per-group pilot as biological proof.

evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json:26-27 and :35-36 report KJ 5766 reconstructed/5517 technical-valid and WT 3541/3423.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:29-31 and :479-481 reports the same reconstructed and technical-valid counts.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:5-14 records one specimen per group and inference_status=insufficient_specimens.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/01_biological_results/data/biological_statistical_tests.csv:2-8 labels biological specimen analysis with n=1 per group and insufficient_specimens.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z035_stages.png show labeled raw, probability, mask, instance-boundary, centerline, and final-overlay stages with consistent ROI framing and no apparent clipping.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json records the retained stage artifacts and their repository paths.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png explicitly label raw data, U-Net support, neighboring boundaries, target masks, boundaries, and centerlines; inspected panels show overlays following target objects and consistent crop framing.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json records both tracking artifacts and source dimensions with crop_touches_source_edge=false for displayed examples.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:5-14 marks inference insufficient with one specimen per group.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:5 and :19 state sensitivity rows are descriptive and not biological results.

limitations: The PDF rendering itself was not independently rasterized in this environment; PDF integrity and numeric-token validation are recorded in audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:20-31, while visual inspection covered the retained PNG stage and tracking evidence.
